comments.body:
Reopening this — I closed it right after filing #34738, which in hindsight was premature: the bug is still present on current main (`8270ac4621`), and the draft never got CI or review.

One update worth recording since then. Removing subscribers by endpoint key alone, which is what #34738 did, turns out to race with re-registration: node-failure cleanup and `STAGING_REQ` handling run on different threads, so a restarted prefill can re-register on the same endpoints between the cleanup computing its stale-endpoint list and actually deleting — and the delete then removes the fresh subscriber, recreating the exact hang the cleanup is meant to prevent. We ran into this while soak-testing the fix, not just in theory.

New PR with a generation-based cleanup and a regression test for that race: #36049. It supersedes #34738, which I'll close. I've also fixed the launch snippets above: they were missing `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1`, without which the staging path never activates.

title: [Bug] Stale staging watermark subscribers survive prefill failure
